annotation.interpretation_a: The server may include an Upgrade header in any response if it deems it appropriate for a future request, allowing the server to decide based on context (e.g., if the client might request an upgrade later).
annotation.interpretation_b: The server may include an Upgrade header only if it has evidence that a future request will request an upgrade (such as a prior Upgrade request header from the client), implying the server must know the client’s intent before advertising the header.
annotation.justification: The clause does not define what makes a future request 'appropriate', leading to multiple reasonable implementation behaviours regarding when the Upgrade header may be sent.
